MASK32 = 0xFFFFFFFF
MAX_FINITE = 0x7F7FFFFF
MIN_NORMAL = 0x00800000
CANONICAL_NAN = 0x7FC00001


def classify(bits):
    sign = (bits >> 31) & 1
    exponent = (bits >> 23) & 0xFF
    fraction = bits & 0x7FFFFF

    if exponent == 0xFF:
        if fraction == 0:
            return "inf", sign, 0, 0
        return "nan", sign, fraction, 0

    if exponent == 0:
        if fraction == 0:
            return "zero", sign, 0, 0
        return "finite", sign, fraction, -149

    return "finite", sign, (1 << 23) | fraction, exponent - 127 - 23

    exponent = numerator.bit_length() - denominator.bit_length()
    if exponent >= 0:
        if numerator < (denominator << exponent):
            exponent -= 1
    elif (numerator << (-exponent)) < denominator:
        exponent -= 1
    return exponent


def rounded_quotient(numerator, denominator, unit_exponent, sign, mode):
    if unit_exponent >= 0:
        numerator_scaled = numerator
        denominator_scaled = denominator << unit_exponent
    else:
        numerator_scaled = numerator << (-unit_exponent)
        denominator_scaled = denominator

    quotient, remainder = divmod(numerator_scaled, denominator_scaled)
    if remainder == 0:
        return quotient, False

    if mode == 0:
        twice_remainder = remainder << 1
        if twice_remainder > denominator_scaled:
            quotient += 1
        elif twice_remainder == denominator_scaled and (quotient & 1):
            quotient += 1
    elif mode == 2 and sign == 0:
        quotient += 1
    elif mode == 3 and sign == 1:
        quotient += 1

    return quotient, True

    if to_infinity:
        return (sign << 31) | 0x7F800000
    return (sign << 31) | MAX_FINITE

    if numerator == 0:
        return 0, False, False, False

    sign = int(numerator < 0)
    magnitude = abs(numerator)
    exponent = floor_log2_ratio(magnitude, denominator)

            magnitude, denominator, exponent - 23, sign, mode

        bits = (sign << 31) | ((exponent + 127) << 23) | (significand & 0x7FFFFF)

    else:

            expected["div_by_zero"] = 0
            return expected

        if class_b == "inf":
            result = result_sign << 31
            expected["out"] = result
            expected["inf"] = 0
            expected["qnan"] = 0
            expected["ine"] = 0
            expected["overflow"] = 0
            expected["underflow"] = 0
            expected["zero"] = 1
            expected["div_by_zero"] = 0
            return expected

        sig_a, scale_a = finite_term(opa)
        sig_b, scale_b = finite_term(opb)

        if sig_b == 0:
            result = (result_sign << 31) | 0x7F800000
            expected["out"] = result
            expected["inf"] = 1
            expected["qnan"] = 0
            expected["ine"] = 0
            expected["overflow"] = 0
            expected["underflow"] = 0
            expected["zero"] = 0
            expected["div_by_zero"] = int(sig_a != 0)
            return expected

        if sig_a == 0:
            result = result_sign << 31
            expected["out"] = result
            expected["inf"] = 0
            expected["qnan"] = 0
            expected["ine"] = 0
            expected["overflow"] = 0
            expected["underflow"] = 0
            expected["zero"] = 1
            expected["div_by_zero"] = 0
            return expected

        numerator = sig_a
        denominator = abs(sig_b)
        if sig_b < 0:
            numerator = -numerator

        result, inexact, overflow, underflow = encode_rational(
            numerator, denominator, scale_a - scale_b, mode
        )

    magnitude = result & 0x7FFFFFFF
    result_is_inf = magnitude == 0x7F800000
    result_is_zero = magnitude == 0
    expected["out"] = result
    expected["inf"] = int(result_is_inf)
    expected["qnan"] = 0
    expected["ine"] = int(inexact)
    expected["overflow"] = int(overflow)
    expected["underflow"] = int(underflow)
    expected["zero"] = int(result_is_zero)
    expected["div_by_zero"] = 0

    if op in (2, 3) and magnitude <= 0x00800000:
        expected["out"] = None
        expected["zero"] = None
        expected["underflow"] = None

    if op == 3 and classify(opa)[1] == "finite":
        exponent_a = (opa >> 23) & 0xFF
        fraction_a = opa & 0x7FFFFF
        if exponent_a == 0 and fraction_a != 0:
            expected["ine"] = None
            expected["underflow"] = None

    return expected


def make_vector(op, mode, opa, opb):
    return (op, mode, opa, opb, expected_result(op, mode, opa, opb))


def generate_vectors():
    vectors = []
    values = [
        0x00000000,
        0x80000000,
        0x00000001,
        0x00000002,
        0x007FFFFF,
        0x00800000,
        0x00800001,
        0x3F000000,
        0x3F800000,
        0x3F800001,
        0x40000000,
        0x40400000,
        0x4B000000,
        0x7F7FFFFF,
        0xFF7FFFFF,
        0x7F800000,
        0xFF800000,
        0x7FC12345,
        0xFFC54321,
        0x7F800001,
        0xFF800001,
    ]

    for mode in range(4):
        for op in range(4):
            for a in values:
                for b in values:
                    vectors.append(make_vector(op, mode, a, b))

    rng = Random(0x5A17C0DE)
    for _ in range(1800):
        mode = rng.randrange(4)
        op = rng.randrange(4)

        def random_finite():
            sign = rng.randrange(2) << 31
            if rng.randrange(5) == 0:
                return sign | rng.randrange(1, 0x800000)
            exponent = rng.randrange(1, 255)
            fraction = rng.randrange(1 << 23)
            return sign | (exponent << 23) | fraction

        a = random_finite()
        b = random_finite()
        if rng.randrange(5) == 0:
            a = values[rng.randrange(15)]
        if rng.randrange(5) == 0:
            b = values[rng.randrange(15)]
        vectors.append(make_vector(op, mode, a, b))

    return vectors


@cocotb.test()
async def fpu_behavior(dut):
    vectors = generate_vectors()
    idle = make_vector(0, 0, 0, 0)
    vectors.extend([idle, idle, idle, idle])

    cocotb.start_soon(Clock(dut.clk, CLK_NS, "ns").start())
    dut.rmode.value = 0
    dut.fpu_op.value = 0
    dut.opa.value = 0
    dut.opb.value = 0

    for index, vector in enumerate(vectors):
        op, mode, opa, opb, expected = vector

        await FallingEdge(dut.clk)
        dut.fpu_op.value = op
        dut.rmode.value = mode
        dut.opa.value = opa
        dut.opb.value = opb

        await RisingEdge(dut.clk)
        await Timer(1, unit="ns")

        if index >= 3:
            checked = vectors[index - 3][4]
            for name in ("out",) + FLAG_NAMES:
                wanted = checked[name]
                if wanted is None:
                    continue
                observed = int(getattr(dut, name).value)
                assert observed == wanted, (
                    f"edge {index}, operation {vectors[index - 3][0]}, "
                    f"mode {vectors[index - 3][1]}, "
                    f"opa 0x{vectors[index - 3][2]:08X}, "
                    f"opb 0x{vectors[index - 3][3]:08X}: "
                    f"{name} expected 0x{wanted:X}, got 0x{observed:X}"
                )
